scripts.gen:types: node scripts/py.mjs ../scripts/gen_schema.py && npm --prefix frontend run gen:types
scripts.check:types: node scripts/py.mjs ../scripts/gen_schema.py --check && npm --prefix frontend run check:types
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check . && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --fix . && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/py.mjs -m mypy && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:types && npm run test:api && npm run build
